checksumRule: Rendered or archived media must record a 64-character SHA-256 checksum in lecture-video.json before publish.
largeFileStorageDecision: Store rendered lecture media in the ignored local archive for now; defer Git LFS or object storage until a publishing workflow needs versioned media distribution.
requiredForPublishRule: Required lecture media must be rendered or archived locally with checksums before the course can depend on it.
notes: Keep manifests, scripts, captions, transcripts, storyboard, and QA metadata in Git.
Keep large binary audio and video files out of Git unless this policy is replaced by an explicit large-file storage decision.
External hosted videos may be optional references, but required instruction must have local rendered or archived media.
